DSH原生MIT bundle/preset工具集0.2.0/Node>=18；模型路由伴随依赖与本地Skills另有归属，当前Host/发布物未验。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 必需性 | 用途 | 缺失/边界 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Node>=18/DSH tools/approval/Web | 对应路径必需 | 加载/审批/UI | 当前Host未运行 |
| SSH/SCP/bash/远端账户 | 远程必需 | 真脚本/传输 | 账户权限非插件沙箱 |
| SLURM或nohup/setsid/timeout | 按模式 | 后台计算 | 实际可用/取消须验 |
| 项目独立scratch/数据环境 | 采用前提 | 控Jxx冲突与复现 | 配额只本项目记录 |
| dsh-model-tier^0.1.0/模型 | 伴随路由 | 单独依赖/选择 | 本轮不全验发布行为 |

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | Host/SSH/环境/账户未知 | 权限/数据/脚本/目录核对 | 未安装/连接 |
| 持续 | 模型/远端CPU-GPU/磁盘网络未知 | 审原始数据/方法/结果 | 无总费用封顶 |
| 故障 | 孤儿job/冲突/残留未知 | 查PID/SLURM/状态 | 本地kill非远端停止 |
| 退出 | scratch/产物/日志留存未知 | 真停机/清远端/备份 | 卸载非数据计算撤回 |

结论状态 源码支持记录/归档和代表远程执行；取消状态、审批/目录/UI安全及恢复边界显著，观察。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：dsh-science0.2.0是MIT、Node>=18的DSH原生bundle/研究preset/Skills工具集，面向能审数据/脚本/结论的科研开发者。包把research/artifact/remote引擎和远程主机UI装入profile，另依赖dsh-model-tier^0.1.0；并非独立模型/科学验证器。基线是实验笔记+git/文件hash、手工SSH/SLURM或原生可信远程工具组合，成功须输入/脚本/目标和真实结果可对账，并经独立科学/数据验收。 - **亮点**：[Q02](#research-q02)结构化问题假设/实验记录；[Q03](#research-q03)版本文件/来源/hash；[Q04](#research-q04)可追真实远端执行接线，而非独立科学验证。 - **思考**：[Q04](#research-q04)approve参数可跳作业审批、远端先启动本地后记、项目Jxx/scratch冲突；[Q05](#research-q05)取消失败仍标killed、unknown/输出/UI权限和写锁边界限制采用。 - **建议**：[Q06](#research-q06)分开提交/真实终止/独立结果验收收据与唯一项目远端命名，先比人工清单/小修，不算已有成果。 采用建议：[Q06](#research-q06)观察；低敏本地记录先核，远端需私有Host/独立账户与唯一scratch，未知回手工对账。 ## 核心贡献 [Q02](#research-q02)结构化问题假设/实验记录；[Q03](#research-q03)版本文件/来源/hash；[Q04](#research-q04)可追真实远端执行接线，而非独立科学验证。 ## 关键质疑 [Q04](#research-q04)approve参数可跳作业审批、远端先启动本地后记、项目Jxx/scratch冲突；[Q05](#research-q05)取消失败仍标killed、unknown/输出/UI权限和写锁边界限制采用。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 必需性 | 用途 | 缺失/边界 | |---|---|---|---| | Node>=18/DSH tools/approval/Web | 对应路径必需 | 加载/审批/UI | 当前Host未运行 | | SSH/SCP/bash/远端账户 | 远程必需 | 真脚本/传输 | 账户权限非插件沙箱 | | SLURM或nohup/setsid/timeout | 按模式 | 后台计算 | 实际可用/取消须验 | | 项目独立scratch/数据环境 | 采用前提 | 控Jxx冲突与复现 | 配额只本项目记录 | | dsh-model-tier^0.1.0/模型 | 伴随路由 | 单独依赖/选择 | 本轮不全验发布行为 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 动作 | 判据/失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 记录 | 低敏固定数据/人工计划 | phase非科学验收 | | 归档 | 小文件/输入环境/hash | reproduce说明须真重跑 | | 准备 | 核私有Host/权限/独立账户scratch | 不凭默认审批 | | 提交 | 一确定输出小任务 | 核真实远端job/本地记录 | | 恢复 | unknown/cancel失败先对账 | 不信killed/不盲重投 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次 | Host/SSH/环境/账户未知 | 权限/数据/脚本/目录核对 | 未安装/连接 | | 持续 | 模型/远端CPU-GPU/磁盘网络未知 | 审原始数据/方法/结果 | 无总费用封顶 | | 故障 | 孤儿job/冲突/残留未知 | 查PID/SLURM/状态 | 本地kill非远端停止 | | 退出 | scratch/产物/日志留存未知 | 真停机/清远端/备份 | 卸载非数据计算撤回 | #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | |---|---|---| | 研究记录 | 真manifest/状态写 | 科学结论/自治循环 | | 产物版本 | 真复制/hash/provenance | 完整环境/自动复现 | | 远端执行 | 真SSH/SLURM/后台 | 不丢不重/全局配额 | | 状态/取消 | 真probe/cancel与记录 | killed对应真实停机 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：区分研究记录/归档与真实SSH执行，核审批/持久/取消/拉回/UI关键边界，不以状态当科学验证。 ### Q01 · 它是自动科学Agent，还是给Host组织研究与远程工具的插件？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 dsh-science0.2.0是MIT、Node>=18的DSH原生bundle/研究preset/Skills工具集，面向能审数据/脚本/结论的科研开发者。包把research/artifact/remote引擎和远程主机UI装入profile，另依赖dsh-model-tier^0.1.0；并非独立模型/科学验证器。基线是实验笔记+git/文件hash、手工SSH/SLURM或原生可信远程工具组合，成功须输入/脚本/目标和真实结果可对账，并经独立科学/数据验收。 作者称ReAct research-loop和11Skills，但所核research工具主要登记/推进状态并给下一步建议，实际模型决策和工具调用循环由DSH/模型承担。artifact_reproduce也只输出重跑步骤，不执行命令。远程执行才有真shell/SSH/SLURM副作用，不能把研究phase或hash一致等同实验正确、可重复结论或临床有效。 companion模型分档的包声明/patch另有归属；当前patch说明虚拟provider按会话opt-in，与README早期全局waterfall叙述不可混同。本轮未全审该依赖发布物/路由和本地科学Skills，不将其宣传收益归为本根已验证贡献。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[package.json:1-7](https://github.com/biociao/dsh-science/blob/23767ab2f8d7bcf84a0820daa4c6ae79549da000/package.json#L1-L7) 当前身份/版本/MIT。 ```text { "name": "dsh-science", "version": "0.2.0", "description": "Claude Science-style research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), SSH remote-compute engine for long bioinformatics jobs on workstations/HPC (remote_* tools), and 11 science skills for genomics / pathogens / bioinformatics.       "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-science \n[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-science)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-science)\n[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-science)](LICENSE)\n[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-339933)](package.json)\n[![dsh-plugin topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-topic%3A%20dsh--plugin-181717)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)\n---\n<img width=\"865\" height=\"795\" alt=\"Screenshot 2026-08-14 at 19 49 06\" src=\"https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b6ef210f-6081-42b7-91fd-484f554c955e\" />\n\n**A Claude Science–style research workbench for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — for genomics / pathogens / human health / bioinformatics projects.**\n\n> One-liner: **dsh-science** — Claude Science-style research workbench for DSH: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), an SSH remote-compute engine (remote_* tools, mirroring Claude Science's Computer / Remote compute clusters), and 11 science skills for genomics / pathogens / bioinformatics.\n\n- **ReAct research loop engine** — `research_init` / `research_state` / `research_hypothesis` / `research_experiment` / `research_findings` / `research_phase` / `research_review` / `research_report`, persisted in a `research-manifest.json` state machine (Question → Hypothesis → Experiment → Observe → Analyze → Conclude → Next Question).\n- **Versioned artifacts with provenance** — `artifact_save` / `artifact_list` / `artifact_show` / `artifact_diff` / `artifact_verify` / `artifact_deprecate` / `artifact_reproduce`: every result saved as `artifacts/<name>/v<N>/` with per-file SHA-256, `artifact.json` provenance (command / inputs / environment / envFile) and an append-only `provenance.md`.\n- **Remote compute engine (SSH / HPC clusters)** — 16 tools: `remote_host_add` / `remote_host_probe` / `remote_host_notes` / `remote_run` / `remote_status` / `remote_logs` / `remote_pull` / `remote_cancel` / `remote_exec` etc. Connect lab workstations or HPC clusters via `~/.ssh/config` aliases (nothing installed on the host, zero third-party deps). Long bioinformatics jobs run as detached processes on workstations or via `sbatch` on SLURM — they survive connection loss; submission asks for approval by default; `remote_status` batch-monitors and auto-transitions state (running → succeeded/failed/killed); `remote_pull` fetches outputs back (files over the size threshold stay on the host with their paths recorded).\n- **Remote Hosts config UI (bundle/profile-level)** — a Settings > 远程主机 page (the analog of Claude Science's Settings > Compute > SSH hosts): list/add/probe/edit/remove hosts, plus each project's access allowlist and job summary. Host-side REST API (`webServer` route `/dsh-science/remote-hosts/*`, `engines/remote-hosts-ui.mjs`) + client bundle (`client/remote-hosts-ui/`, built by `scripts/build-client-bundle.mjs`) sharing the same data files as the remote engine. Requires a web-process restart to activate (see [docs/remote-hosts-ui.md](docs/remote-hosts-ui.md)).\n- **Model Tier router (tiered, cross-provider)** — via the companion bundle [`dsh-model-tier`](packages/dsh-model-tier/): within one session, automatically routes auxiliary requests (session titles, compaction summaries) and subagent/background tasks to a **light tier**, keeps the main conversation on the **default tier**, and escalates complex work (deep subagent chains, very long inputs) to a **strong tier** — each tier may point at a **different provider** (e.g. strong GLM-5.3 / default deepseek-v4-flash / light minimax-M3), mirroring Claude Code's Opus/Sonnet/Haiku strategy. Built on DSH's native `agent/request` + `llm/stream` waterfall extension points; a no-op when the tier's provider is unregistered. Installed automatically with dsh-science, but also standalone-installable into any profile (`dsh plugin add dsh-model-tier`).\n- **11 science skills** — research-loop, science-project-setup, artifact-provenance, scientific-reviewer, literature-connector, parallel-delegation, manuscript-writing, bioinformatics-toolkit, conda-environments, data-inventory, remote-compute.\n\nAll in-repo engine plugins are **zero-dependency** (Node built-ins + the system OpenSSH binaries, sharing `engines/core.mjs`) and register plain cordis tools; the companion `dsh-model-tier` router is likewise zero-dependency. Installable either as a profile bundle (`dsh plugin add`) or as an agent preset (`科学模式`).\n\n### v0.2.0: Model Tier router (new, companion bundle)\n\nMirrors Claude Code's Opus/Sonnet/Haiku tiering: within one session, auxiliary requests (`purpose ∈ {session-title, compaction}`) and subagents (`session.meta.origin === 'subagent'`) are routed to the **light tier**; the main conversation keeps its own per-session model selection (never overridden); deep subagent chains (`delegationDepth ≥ subagentDepthStrong`) and very long inputs (`escalateOnChars`, opt-in) escalate to the **strong tier**. An optional LLM pre-classifier (`routing.classify`) grades each user prompt / subtask dispatch by complexity (light / default / strong) before routing. Each tier is `{provider, model, reasoningEffort?}` and may span providers.\n\nShips as the standalone bundle **[`dsh-model-tier`](packages/dsh-model-tier/)** — dsh-science depends on it and mounts it in its `cordis.patch.yml`, but it can equally be installed on its own into any profile (`dsh plugin add dsh-model-tier`):\n\n```yaml\n- id: model-tier\n  name: dsh-model-tier\n  config:\n    tiers:\n      strong: { provider: zai-coding-cn, model: glm-5.3 }\n      default: { provider: deepseek-official, model: deepseek-v4-flash }\n      light: { provider: opencode-go, model: minimax-m2.7 }\n    routing:\n      auxiliary: [session-title, compaction]\n      subagents: light\n      subagentDepthStrong: 3\n```\n\n- **Host plane** — mounted in the profile bundle (`cordis.patch.yml`), not the agent preset, so it applies to every session and subagent on the profile.\n- **Safety rails** — no `tiers` configured → inert no-op; target provider unregistered → no routing; a failing light-tier call automatically falls back to the original route (auxiliary features never break).\n- **Verified** — `node packages/dsh-model-tier/test/model-tier.test.mjs` (zero-dependency unit matrix) + `bash packages/dsh-model-tier/scripts/test-model-tier.sh` (E2E: light tier pointed at a local mock LLM; asserts the title request is actually routed).\n\n### v0.2.0: Remote compute (new)\n\nMirrors Claude Science's **Remote compute clusters / Computer** capability, following its documented mechanism:\n\n- **Host registration + read-only probe** — `remote_host_add` takes a `~/.ssh/config` alias (or `user@host`; ProxyJump etc. handled by OpenSSH), with optional port/identityFile overrides; probing records CPUs, memory, GPUs, CUDA driver, conda/module/Apptainer presence, scratch dirs, `sbatch` and SLURM partitions (`remote_host_probe` re-runs it). Host registry: `$DSH_HOME/remotes/hosts.json`.\n- **Job submission** — `remote_run` copies script + inputs into `<scratch>/<jobId>/` (default `~/dsh-scratch`); workstations run it as a detached `nohup+setsid` process (connection-loss safe), SLURM clusters get `sbatch` (with `--time`); default job timeout 30 min; submission asks for approval by default (the analog of Claude Science's \"Run this job on <host>?\" card).\n- **Monitoring & reaction** — `remote_status` batch-probes (ps / squeue+sacct / done+exitcode markers) and auto-transitions state; `remote_logs` tails logs; `remote_pull` fetches outputs and writes `pulled-manifest.json` (files > 100 MB stay on the host with recorded paths); `remote_cancel` kills (process group / scancel). Job registry: `<project>/.dsh/remotes/jobs.json`, persists across sessions.\n- **Host Details document** — `remote_host_notes` maintains per-host notes (environment activation, partitions/account, conventions) that the model reads before submitting jobs.\n- **Per-project access allowlist (allowed servers, isolated per project)** — every host-connecting action (add/probe, `remote_host_probe`, `remote_exec`, `remote_run`) requires the host to be in the project's allowlist (`.dsh/remotes/allowlist.json`) by default; **first use pops an approval dialog** and, on approval, persists the grant at project scope (the analog of Claude Science's \"This project\" approval scope). The project root resolves by priority: `research-manifest.json` (research project) → `.dsh` (workspace) → `.git` → session cwd — **multiple research projects in one workspace keep separate allowlists**; grants never leak across projects (authorization paths fail closed when no session cwd is available). Review with `remote_host_allowlist`, revoke with `remote_host_revoke`, pre-grant with `remote_host_allow` (approval-gated); disable with `requireHostAccess: false` for unattended runs.\n\n### v0.1.1 hardening (robustness update)\n\n- **Concurrency-safe state**: all manifest/artifact writes go through a lightweight file lock (O_EXCL + stale reclaim) and atomic tmp+rename — parallel subagents can no longer corrupt or lose updates on `research-manifest.json` / `artifacts.json`.\n- **Structured error codes** (`ERR_NOT_INIT` / `ERR_NOT_FOUND` / `ERR_VALIDATION` / `ERR_PATH` / `ERR_QUOTA` / `ERR_LOCK_TIMEOUT` / `ERR_IO`) instead of opaque strings.\n- **Hypothesis state machine** (proposed → testing → supported/refuted/inconclusive) and **forward-only phase transitions** (rewind requires config).\n- **manifest ↔ artifacts linked**: `research_state` merges the artifact index; `artifact_save` writes back to the manifest.\n- **Manifest schema v1→v2 migration** on load, persisted on next write.\n- **Artifact upgrades**: streaming SHA-256 (big files), identical-content dedup via hardlink, `artifact_diff` / `artifact_verify` / `artifact_deprecate`, envFile + input hashes in provenance.\n- **Structured JSON outputs** (`research_report`, `artifact_diff`, `artifact_verify`) and an audit log at `<root>/.science.log`.\n\n## Install\n\n### Option A — profile bundle (community standard)\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile web add dsh-science            # after npm publish\n# or straight from GitHub:\ndsh plugin --profile web add \"github:biociao/dsh-science\"\n```\n\nRestart the profile (or refresh the Web GUI). The bundle inserts the three engines\ninto the profile layer stack; the `research_*` / `artifact_*` / `remote_*` tools\nbecome available to every agent on that profile.\n\n### Option B — agent preset (full 科学模式 experience, per-agent)\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/biociao/dsh-science ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/science\n# or from a local checkout:\nbash scripts/install.sh          # copy   (or: bash scripts/install.sh link)\n```\n\nThen create a session in the DSH Web GUI and pick the **科学模式** preset — the\npreset carries the research persona + engines with per-agent scoping.\n\n### Skills\n\nThe 11 skills are discovered automatically from a project's `.dsh/skills/`\n(drop this repo's `skills/` into your project), or install them machine-wide:\n\n```bash\nbash scripts/install-skills.sh          # -> ~/.dsh/skills (respects $DSH_HOME)\n```\n\n## Quick start (first session)\n\n1. `research_init` — create `research-manifest.json` + the project skeleton\n   (`experiments/ literature/ artifacts/ analyses/ figures/ manuscript/ reviews/ data/ envs/`).\n2. Read `research_state` at the start of every session; the loop state persists\n   across sessions.\n3. Run the loop: `research_hypothesis` (H1/H2/…) → `research_experiment` (E01/…,\n   creates `experiments/<id>/{design.md,log.md,code/,results/}`) → run code →\n   `research_findings` (appends to log.md, updates hypothesis status, advances\n   the loop) → `artifact_save` for anything worth citing or reproducing.\n4. When GPU/cluster/specialized environments are needed: `remote_host_add` the host\n   → `remote_run` a background job (approval required) → poll `remote_status` /\n   `remote_logs` → `remote_pull` outputs when done → `artifact_save` to archive.\n   See [docs/remote-compute.md](docs/remote-compute.md) and the `remote-compute` skill.\n5. For key claims: extract the claim, have a review subagent check it against the\n   execution records (see the `scientific-reviewer` skill), archive with\n   `research_review` (writes `reviews/R0n/report.md`).\n\n## Repository layout\n\n```\ndsh-science/\n├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch -> ./cordis.patch.yml (+ dsh.client + exports)\n├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch: inserts the engines by subpath export + mounts dsh-model-tier\n├── packages/\n│   └── dsh-model-tier/   # 配套独立 bundle：模型分档路由（可单独 dsh plugin add）\n├── engines/              # canonical engine sources (bundle form)\n│   ├── core.mjs          #   shared core: locks, atomic writes, error codes, streaming sha256, structured tools, audit\n│   ├── research-loop.mjs\n│   ├── artifact-registry.mjs\n│   ├── remote-compute.mjs#   SSH/local transports, host registry + probe, job submit/monitor/pull/cancel\n│   └── remote-hosts-ui.mjs#  Remote Hosts 设置页的宿主 REST API（webServer 路由）\n├── client/               # client 插件（设置页 UI，bundle/profile 级）\n│   └── remote-hosts-ui/  #   src/index.js 源码 · lib/client.js 打包产物（build-client-bundle.mjs）\n├── preset/               # agent-preset form (mirrors engines/ via sync-engines.sh)\n│   ├── agent.cordis.yml  #   references ./engines/*.mjs (relative, preset mount)\n│   ├── preset.yml\n│   └── engines/          #   mirror — keep in sync: bash scripts/sync-engines.sh\n├── skills/               # 11 SKILL.md skills\n├── scripts/\n│   ├── install.sh        # install preset -> ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/science\n│   ├── install-skills.sh # install skills -> ~/.dsh/skills\n│   ├── sync-engines.sh   # mirror engines/ -> preset/engines/\n│   ├── init-project.sh   # project skeleton without a science session\n│   ├── build-client-bundle.mjs # wrap client src -> __ModuleLoader__ bundle (lib/client.js)\n│   ├── smoke-test.mjs    # 125 checks against a temp workspace (node >= 18)\n│   └── stability-test.mjs# 25 concurrency/atomicity/stress checks (locks, lost-update, soak, migration)\n└── test/verify-bundle.sh # isolated end-to-end bundle install + boot + client scan check\n```\n\n## Verification\n\n```bash\nnode scripts/smoke-test.mjs       # engine logic + end-to-end loop + error codes + migration\nnode scripts/stability-test.mjs   # concurrency / atomicity / lock / stress stability checks\nbash test/verify-bundle.sh        # pnpm pack -> isolated profile -> install -> boot check\n```\n\nAll are part of the release checklist and are safe to run in CI (both test scripts\nwrite only to a temp workspace; the bundle test uses an isolated `$DSH_HOME`).\n\n## FAQ\n\n**Why subpath exports and not relative paths in the bundle?**\n`dsh plugin add` installs the package into the profile and its `cordis.patch.yml`\nrows join the profile composition. The profile loader resolves a row `name`\nrelative to the **profile directory** (not the package), so `./engines/x.mjs`\nfails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`. Referencing `dsh-science/engines/x.mjs`\n(subpath export, `exports` in `package.json`) resolves from the profile's\n`node_modules` and works — verified experimentally on dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`.\nThe agent-preset mount, by contrast, resolves relative names from the preset\ndirectory, which is why `preset/agent.cordis.yml` can use `./engines/*.mjs`.\n\n**Bundle or preset — which should I use?**\n- Bundle: tools available to every agent on the profile; one command to install.\n- Preset: the full 科学模式 experience (research persona, per-agent scoping).\n  The persona row in `cordis.patch.yml` is commented out because a profile-wide\n  persona would apply to all agents — uncomment it before publishing if that is\n  what you want.\n\n**Where do the skills come from?**\nA project's `.dsh/skills/` is auto-discovered; `scripts/install-skills.sh` puts\nthem machine-wide in `~/.dsh/skills` (respecting `$DSH_HOME`).\n\n## Development\n\nBranching model & release workflow (main = release, dev = integration, `feat/*` = features,\ntag-triggered npm publish + GitHub Release via Actions): see\n[docs/branching.md](docs/branching.md).\n\n```bash\nbash scripts/sync-engines.sh    # after editing engines/*.mjs — keeps preset/engines in sync\nnode scripts/smoke-test.mjs     # logic + static package checks\nnode scripts/stability-test.mjs # concurrency / atomicity / lock stability checks\nbash test/verify-bundle.sh      # end-to-end bundle install + boot\n```\n\n**Workspace-isolation patch** — DSH's New Session used to fall back to the most\nrecently used Workspace, letting automation spawn sessions into unrelated\nprojects. `scripts/patch-session-isolation.mjs` applies the one-line guard\n(idempotent, backs up first; re-apply after every `dsh` upgrade). See\n[docs/workspace-isolation.md](docs/workspace-isolation.md).\n\n```bash\nnode scripts/patch-session-isolation.mjs apply   # idempotent, backs up first\nnode scripts/patch-session-isolation.mjs status  # check current state\nnode scripts/patch-session-isolation.mjs revert  # restore pristine file\n```\n\n## Community\n\n- Topic: [github.com/topics/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)\n- Curated lists: [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) · [awesome-deepseek-harness](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness)\n\n## License\n\nMIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).\n"

      "content": "// science-artifact-registry —— 模仿 Claude Science 的工件与溯源（Artifacts + Provenance）\n//\n// 零第三方依赖（只用 node 内置模块），作为科学模式 preset 的本地插件被挂载。\n// 管理 <项目根>/artifacts/<name>/：\n//   - v<N>/         每次保存生成一个新版本目录（源文件/目录的副本）\n//   - artifact.json 版本索引与溯源元数据（命令、输入、输出、环境、SHA-256）\n//   - provenance.md 人类可读的溯源日志（追加式）\n//   - artifacts/artifacts.json 全局工件索引\n// 等价于 Claude Science 的\"结果保存为带完整执行记录（provenance）的版本化工件\"。\n//\n// v0.1.1 修复（相对 v0.1.0，鲁棒性更新）：\n//   A 并发一致性：所有写操作经 artifacts/.lock 串行 + 原子写；\n//     版本号从最大版本推导；同一文件重复保存时按 path+sha256 去重（硬链接，失败退化为复制）。\n//   B 校验：路径越界（ERR_PATH）、大小配额（ERR_QUOTA）、参数校验统一错误码。\n//   C 工件系统：流式 SHA-256（大文件不爆内存）；新增 artifact_diff（版本对比）、\n//     artifact_verify（重算哈希校验）、artifact_deprecate（标记废弃）；\n//     溯源增强：envFile 参数（记录环境文件哈希）、inputs 自动记录 inputHashes；\n//     artifact_save 会尽力回写 research-manifest.json 的 artifacts[]（打通清单仪表盘）。\n//   D 架构：错误码化、审计日志、artifact_diff / artifact_verify 结构化 JSON 输出。\n\nimport { promises as fsp, existsSync } from \"node:fs\";\nimport path from \"node:path\";\nimport * as core from \"./core.mjs\";\n\nexport const name = \"science-artifact-registry\";\nexport const inject = [\"tools\"];\n\nconst DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 ** 3; // 8 GiB（可通过 config.maxFileBytes 覆盖）\n\nfunction withinRoot(root, rel) {\n  const abs = path.resolve(root, rel);\n  const r = path.resolve(root);\n  if (abs !== r && !abs.startsWith(r + path.sep)) {\n    throw core.sciErr(\"ERR_PATH\", `路径越出项目根：${rel}`);\n  }\n  return abs;\n}\n\nfunction sessionLabel(exec) {\n  try {\n    const sid = exec?.agent?.session?.id;\n    if (typeof sid === \"string\" && sid.length) return sid.slice(0, 12);\n  } catch {\n    /* 忽略 */\n  }\n  return \"model\";\n}\n\nfunction normalizeRel(p) {\n  return p.split(path.sep).join(\"/\");\n}\n\n// ── 插件入口 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunction apply(ctx, config = {}) {\n  const markers = Array.isArray(config.markers) && config.markers.length ? config.markers : [\".dsh\", \".git\"];\n  const maxFileBytes = config.maxFileBytes ?? };\n\n  const audit = async (args, exec) => {\n    try {\n      return await core.resolveRoot(args, exec, markers);\n    } catch {\n      return undefined;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const artifactsLockPath = async (root) => {\n    await fsp.mkdir(path.join(root, \"artifacts\"), { recursive: true });\n    return path.join(root, \"artifacts\", \".lock\");\n  };\n\n  // ── artifact_save：保存一个版本化工件并记录溯源 ──\n  ctx.tools.register(core.makeTool({\n    name: \"artifact_save\",\n    description:\n      \"把分析结果/图表/数据保存为版本化工件（等价于 Claude Science 的 Artifacts）：复制 sources 指定的文件或目录到 artifacts/<name>/v<N>/，流式计算每个文件的 destAbs);\n              return { path: relPath, sha256: sha, size: st.size, linkedFrom: `v${cand.version}` };\n            } catch {\n              /* 跨设备等 → 退化为复制 */\n            }\n          }\n          await fsp.copyFile(srcAbs, destAbs);\n          return { path: relPath, sha256: sha, size: st.size };\n        };\n\n        const files = [];\n        for (const rel of rawSources) {\n          const src = withinRoot(root, rel);\n          let st;\n          try {\n            st = await fsp.stat(src);\n          } catch (err) {\n            throw core.sciErr(\"ERR_NOT_FOUND\",       const inputHashes = [];\n        for (const inp of core.asList(args.inputs)) {\n          try {\n            const abs = withinRoot(root, inp);\n            const st = await fsp.stat(abs);\n    (envEntry ? ` / env ${envEntry.path}#${envEntry.sha256.slice(0, 12)}` : \"\");\n\n        const entry = {\n          version,\n          created: core.nowISO(),\n          author:  return findProjectRoot(base, markers);\n}\n\n// ── 原子读写 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport async function readJson(p, fallback) {\n  let raw;\n  try {\n    raw continue;\n          }\n        } catch {\n          continue; // 锁刚被释放\n        }\n        if (Date.now() - start > timeoutMs) {\n          throw sciErr(\"ERR_LOCK_TIMEOUT\", reject);\n  });\n  return h.digest(\"hex\");\n}\n\n// ── 目录文件收集 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport async function collectFiles(dir, base) {\n  const out = [];\n       "content": "// science-remote-hosts-ui —— 远程主机配置 UI 的宿主侧（webServer REST API）\n//\n// 对应 Claude Science 的 Settings > Compute > SSH hosts。浏览器侧 UI 通过\n// fetch 调用本插件注册的 HTTP 路由，读写与 remote-compute 引擎同一套数据：\n//   主机注册表 $DSH_HOME/remotes/hosts.json（全机）\n//   白名单 / 作业 <项目根>/.dsh/remotes/allowlist.json、jobs.json（按项目）\n// 并支持真实 ssh 只读探测（CPU/GPU/CUDA/conda/sbatch/SLURM 分区）。\n//\n// 零第三方依赖（node 内置模块 + 系统 OpenSSH）。作为 bundle 行挂载于 profile\n// （cordis.patch.yml），不进入 agent preset（设置页是 profile 级 UI）。\n//\n// v0.2.0 新增。\n\nimport { promises as fsp, existsSync } from \"node:fs\";\nimport path from \"node:path\";\nimport os from \"node:os\";\nimport { spawn } from \"node:child_process\";\n\nexport const name = \"science-remote-hosts-ui\";\nexport const inject = [\"webServer\"];\n\nconst HOSTS_DIR = (() => {\n  const base = process.env.DSH_HOME || path.join(os.homedir(), \".dsh\");\n  return path.join(base, \"remotes\");\n})();\n\nfunction hostsFilePath() {\n  return path.join(HOSTS_DIR, \"hosts.json\");\n}\n\nasync function readJson(abs, fallback) {\n  try {\n    return JSON.parse(await fsp.readFile(abs, \"utf8\"));\n  } catch (e) {\n    return fallback;\n  }\n}\n\nasync function writeJson(abs, obj) {\n  await fsp.mkdir(path.dirname(abs), { recursive: true });\n  await fsp.writeFile(abs, JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2) + \"\\n\", \"utf8\");\n}\n\nasync function loadHosts() {\n  const p = hostsFilePath();\n  const d = await readJson(p, { hosts: [] });\n  return { p, hosts: Array.isArray(d.hosts) ? d.hosts : [] };\n}\n\nasync function saveHosts(p, hosts) {\n  await writeJson(p, { schema: 1, hosts, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });\n}\n\n// ── 只读探测（与 remote-compute 引擎同一脚本与解析格式）──────────────────\n\nconst PROBE = [\n  'echo \"UNAME|$(uname -srm)\"',\n  'echo \"CPUS|$(nproc 2>/dev/null || getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null)\"',\n  'm=$(free -b 2>/dev/null | awk \\'NR==2{print $2}\\'); [ -z \"$m\" ] && m=$(sysctl -n hw.memsize 2>/dev/null); echo \"MEMB|$m\"',\n  'if command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv,noheader | sed \"s/^/GPU|/\"; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed \"s/^/CUDA|/\"; else echo \"GPU|none\"; echo \"CUDA|none\"; fi',\n  'for t in conda mamba module apptainer singularity sbatch squeue sacct scancel; do if command -v \"$t\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"TOOL|$t=yes\"; else echo \"TOOL|$t=no\"; fi; done',\n  'if command -v sbatch >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"SLURM|$(sbatch --version 2>&1 | head -1)\"; sinfo -o \"%P|%a|%D|%t\" 2>/dev/null | sed \"s/^/PART|/\"; else echo \"SLURM|none\"; fi',\n].join(\"\\n\");\n\nfunction parseProbe(text) {\n  const p = { os: \"\", cpus: 0, memBytes: 0, gpus: [], cudaDriver: \"\", conda: false, mamba: false, module: false, apptainer: false, singularity: false, sbatch: false, squeue: false, sacct: false, scancel: false, scratchDirs: [], slurmVersion: null, partitions: [] };\n  for (const line of String(text).split(\"\\n\")) {\n    const i = line.indexOf(\"|\");\n    if (i < 0) continue;\n    const k = line.slice(0, i);\n    const v = line.slice(i + 1).trim();\n    if (!v) continue;\n    if (k === \"UNAME\") p.os = v;\n    else if (k === \"CPUS\") p.cpus = Number(v) || 0;\n    else if (k === \"MEMB\") p.memBytes = Number(v) || 0;\n    else if (k === \"GPU\") p.gpus.push(v);\n    else if (k === \"CUDA\") p.cudaDriver = v;\n    else if (k === \"SLURM\") p.slurmVersion = v === \"none\" ? null : v;\n    else if (k === \"PART\") { const s = v.split(\"|\"); p.partitions.push({ name: s[0], avail: s[1], nodes: s[2], state: s[3] }); }\n    else if (k === \"TOOL\") { const nv = v.split(\"=\"); if (nv[0] in p) p[nv[0]] = nv[1] === \"yes\"; }\n  }\n  return p;\n}\n\nfunction probeCommand(host) {\n  const b = Buffer.from(PROBE, \"utf8\").toString(\"base64\");\n  if (host.transport === \"local\") return `bash -c \"echo ${b} | base64 -d | bash\"`;\n  const a = [\"ssh\", \"-o\", \"ConnectTimeout=15\"];\n  if (host.batchMode !== false) a.push(\"-o\", \"BatchMode=yes\");\n  if (host.port) a.push(\"-p\", String(host.port));\n  if (host.identityFile) a.push(\"-i\", host.identityFile);\n  a.push(host.alias || host.id);\n  const safe = (s) => (/^[A-Za-z0-9_\\-.\\/@:]+$/.test(s) ? s : `'${s}'`);\n  return `${a.map(safe).join(\" \")} \"echo ${b} | base64 -d | bash\"`;\n}\n\nfunction runCommand(argv, opts = {}) {\n  return new Promise((resolve) => {\n    const child = spawn(argv[0], argv.slice(1), { stdio: [\"ignore\", \"pipe\", \"pipe\"] });\n    let stdout = \"\", stderr = \"\";\n    child.stdout.on(\"data\", (c) => { stdout += c; });\n    child.stderr.on(\"data\", (c) => { stderr += c; });\n    const timer = opts.timeoutMs ? setTimeout(() => child.kill(\"SIGKILL\"), opts.timeoutMs) : null;\n    child.on(\"close\", (code) => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve({ code, stdout, stderr }); });\n  });\n}\n\nasync function runProbe(host) {\n  try {\n    const res = await runCommand([\"sh\", \"-c\", probeCommand(host)], { timeoutMs: 30000 });\n    if (res.code !== 0) return { ok: false, error: `探测失败(exit ${res.code})：${res.stderr.trim().slice(0, 200) || res.stdout.trim().slice(0, 200)}` };\n    return { ok: true, probe: parseProbe(res.stdout) };\n  } catch (e) {\n    return { ok: false, error: String(e && e.message || e).slice(0, 200) };\n  }\n}\n\n// ── HTTP 辅助 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunction readBody(req, limit = 1 * 1024 * 1024) {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    let buf = \"\";\n    req.on(\"data\", (c) => {\n      buf += c;\n      if (buf.length > limit) { reject(new Error(\"body too large\")); req.destroy(); }\n    });\n    req.on(\"end\", () => resolve(buf ? JSON.parse(buf) : {}));\n    req.on(\"error\", reject);\n  });\n}\n\nfunction send(res, status, obj) {\n  const body = JSON.stringify(obj);\n  res.writeHead(status, { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json; charset=utf-8\", \"Cache-Control\": \"no-store\" });\n  res.end(body);\n}\n\n// 同源校验：只接受浏览器同源请求（防止跨站调用本地服务）\nfunction sameOrigin(req) {\n  const origin = req.headers.origin;\n  if (!origin) return false; // 非浏览器（curl 等）拒绝\n  const host = req.headers.host;\n  if (!host) return false;\n  try {\n    const u = new URL(origin);\n    return u.host === host;\n  } catch (e) {\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\nconst fail = (msg) => ({ ok: false, error: String(msg && msg.message || msg).slice(0, 400) });\nconst projFile = (root, name) => `${root}/.dsh/remotes/${name}.json`;\n\nfunction makeHandlers(ctx) {\n  return {\n    async config() {\n      return { ok: true, dshHome: HOSTS_DIR.replace(/\\/remotes$/, \"\"), hostsFile: hostsFilePath() };\n    },\n    async list() {\n      const { p, hosts } = await loadHosts();\n      return { ok: true, hostsFile: p, hosts };\n    },\n    async addHost(a) {\n      const { p, hosts } = await loadHosts();\n      const id = String(a.host || \"\").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g, \"-\").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, \"\").slice(0, 32);\n      if (!id) return fail(\"host id 不能为空\");\n      if (hosts.some((x) => x.id === id)) return fail(`主机 ${id} 已存在`);\n      const t = a.transport === \"local\" ? \"local\" : \"ssh\";\n      const e = {\n        id, transport: t, alias: t === \"local\" ? \"local\" : String(a.alias || id),\n        notes: String(a.notes || \"\"), scratch: String(a.scratch || \"~/dsh-scratch\"),\n        maxConcurrent: Number(a.maxConcurrent) || 100, timeoutMinutes: Number(a.timeoutMinutes) || 30,\n        port: a.port ? Number(a.port) : undefined, identityFile: a.identityFile ? String(a.identityFile) : undefined,\n        batchMode: a.batchMode !== false, probe: null, probeError: null, probedAt: null,\n        addedAt: new Date().toISOString(), updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n      if (a.probe !== false) {\n        const r = await runProbe(e);\n        if (r.ok) { e.probe = r.probe; e.probedAt = new Date().toISOString(); }\n        else e.probeError = r.error;\n      }\n      hosts.push(e);\n      await saveHosts(p, hosts);\n      return { ok: true, host: e };\n    },\n    async updateHost(a) {\n      const { p, hosts } = await loadHosts();\n      const h = hosts.find((x) => x.id === a.host);\n      if (!h) return fail(`主机 ${a.host} 未注册`);\n      const p2 = a.patch || {};\n      if (\"notes\" in p2) h.notes = String(p2.notes);\n      if (\"scratch\" in p2) h.scratch = String(p2.scratch);\n      if (\"maxConcurrent\" in p2) h.maxConcurrent = Number(p2.maxConcurrent) || h.maxConcurrent;\n      if (\"timeoutMinutes\" in p2) h.timeoutMinutes = Number(p2.timeoutMinutes) || h.timeoutMinutes;\n      if (\"port\" in p2) h.port = p2.port ? Number(p2.port) : undefined;\n      if (\"identityFile\" in p2) h.identityFile = p2.identityFile ? String(p2.identityFile) : undefined;\n      if (\"batchMode\" in p2) h.batchMode = p2.batchMode !== false;\n      if (p2.alias) h.alias = String(p2.alias);\n      h.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n      await saveHosts(p, hosts);\n      return { ok: true, host: h };\n    },\n    async removeHost(a) {\n      const { p, hosts } = await loadHosts();\n      const n = hosts.length;\n      const rest = hosts.filter((x) => x.id !== a.host);\n      if (rest.length === n) return fail(`主机 ${a.host} 未注册`);\n      await saveHosts(p, rest);\n      return { ok: true };\n    },\n    async probeHost(a) {\n      const { p, hosts } = await loadHosts();\n      const h = hosts.find((x) => x.id === a.host);\n      if (!h) return fail(`主机 ${a.host} 未注册`);\n      const r = await runProbe(h);\n      if (r.ok) { h.probe = r.probe; h.probeError = null; h.probedAt = new Date().toISOString(); }\n      else h.probeError = r.error;\n      h.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n      await saveHosts(p, hosts);\n      return { ok: true, probe: h.probe, probeError: h.probeError, probedAt: h.probedAt };\n    },\n    async projectInfo(a) {\n      const root = String(a.root || \"\");\n      if (!root) return { ok: true, allowlist: [], jobs: [], counts: {}, allowlistFile: null, jobsFile: null };\n      const aw = await readJson(projFile(root, \"allowlist\"), { hosts: [] });\n      const jb = await readJson(projFile(root, \"jobs\"), { jobs: [] });\n      const jobs = Array.isArray(jb.jobs) ? jb.jobs : [];\n      const counts = {};\n      for (const j of jobs) counts[j.state] = (counts[j.state] || 0) + 1;\n      return {\n        ok: true,\n        allowlist: Array.isArray(aw.hosts) ? aw.hosts : [],\n        jobs: jobs.slice(-15).reverse().map((j) => ({ id: j.id, host: j.host, title: j.title, state: j.state, exitCode: j.exitCode })),\n        counts,\n        allowlistFile: projFile(root, \"allowlist\"),\n        jobsFile: projFile(root, \"jobs\"),\n      };\n    },\n    async revoke(a) {\n      const root = String(a.root || \"\");\n      if (!root) return fail(\"缺少 root\");\n      const f = projFile(root, \"allowlist\");\n      const d = await readJson(f, { hosts: [] });\n      d.hosts = (d.hosts || []).filter((x) => x.host !== a.host);\n      await writeJson(f, d);\n      return { ok: true };\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nconst METHODS = [\"config\", \"list\", \"add-host\", \"update-host\", \"remove-host\", \"probe-host\", \"project-info\", \"revoke\"];\n\nfunction apply(ctx, config = {}) {\n  const webServer = ctx.get(\"webServer\");\n  if (!webServer) return;\n  const handlers = makeHandlers(ctx);\n  const byName = {\n    config: handlers.config,\n    list: handlers.list,\n    \"add-host\": handlers.addHost,\n    \"update-host\": handlers.updateHost,\n    \"remove-host\": handlers.removeHost,\n    \"probe-host\": handlers.probeHost,\n    \"project-info\": handlers.projectInfo,\n    revoke: handlers.revoke,\n  };\n  const disposer = webServer.register({\n    kind: \"prefix\",\n    path: \"/dsh-science/remote-hosts\",\n    async handler(req, res) {\n      if (req.method !== \"POST\") return send(res, 405, { ok: false, error: \"仅支持 POST\" });\n      if (!sameOrigin(req)) return send(res, 403, { ok: false, error: \"非浏览器同源请求被拒绝（缺少/不匹配 Origin）\" });\n      const name = (req.url || \"\").replace(/^\\/dsh-science\\/remote-hosts\\/?/, \"\").split(\"/\")[0];\n      if (!name || !METHODS.includes(name)) return send(res, 404, { ok: false, error: `未知方法 ${name}` });\n      try {\n        const body = await readBody(req);\n        const result = await byName[name](body || {});\n        send(res, 200, result);\n      } catch (e) {\n        send(res, 400, fail(e));\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  ctx.on(\"dispose\", disposer);\n}\n\nexport { apply };\n"

      "content": "// science-research-loop —— 模仿 Claude Science 研究循环的持久化状态机（ReAct 引擎）\n//\n// 零第三方依赖（只用 node 内置模块），作为科学模式 preset 的本地插件被挂载。\n// 它维护 <项目根>/research-manifest.json：研究问题、假设、实验、发现、循环阶段与历史，\n// 让\"提问 → 假设 → 实验 → 观察 → 分析 → 结论 → 下一个问题\"的循环以结构化状态落盘，\n// 跨会话持续（等价于 Claude Science 的 Project + 研究循环）。\n//\n// v0.1.1 修复（相对 v0.1.0，鲁棒性更新）：\n//   A 并发一致性：所有写操作经 withFileLock 串行 + 原子写（tmp+rename），读方永不见半截；\n//     ID 改由 nextSeqId（最大编号+1）而非数组长度；loop.iteration 语义统一为\"已完成轮次\"；\n//     manifest schema 升级到 2，带 v1→v2 迁移（向后兼容）。\n//   B 校验：假设状态机 proposed→testing→supported/refuted/inconclusive（禁止直跳结论）；\n//     阶段只许前进（回退需 config.allowPhaseRewind）；research_review.verdict 枚举校验；\n//     research_init 空问题给出警告。\n//   C 打通 manifest ↔ artifacts：research_state 实时合并 artifacts/artifacts.json 展示，\n//     artifact_save 会把工件登记回写 manifest.artifacts。\n//   D 架构：错误码化（ERR_*，不再吞成无类型字符串）；research_state 支持 historyLimit 裁剪；\n//     审计日志 <root>/.science.log；新增 research_report（结构化 JSON 输出）；\n//     research_experiment 返回下一步建议。\n\nimport { promises as fsp, existsSync } from \"node:fs\";\nimport path from \"node:path\";\nimport * as core from \"./core.mjs\";\n\nexport const name = \"science-research-loop\";\n\n// 需要 tools 服务就绪后才应用（与其它工具插件一致）\nexport const inject = [\"tools\"];\n\n// ── 常量 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconst SCHEMA = 2;\nconst MANIFEST_FILE = \"research-manifest.json\";\nconst PHASES = [\"literature\", \"hypothesis\", \"experiment\", \"analysis\", \"manuscript\", \"concluded\"];\nconst PHASE_INDEX = Object.fromEntries(PHASES.map((p, i) => [p, i]));\nconst HYP_STATUSES = [\"proposed\", \"testing\", \"supported\", \"refuted\", \"inconclusive\"];\nconst INITIAL_HYP_STATUSES = [\"proposed\", \"testing\"]; // 结论必须经 research_findings/review 产生\nconst REVIEW_VERDICTS = [\"supported\", \"refuted\", \"inconclusive\", \"needs-work\"];\nconst PHASE_LABEL = {\n  literature: \"文献调研\",\n  hypothesis: \"假设提出\",\n  experiment: \"实验设计\",\n  analysis: \"数据分析\",\n  manuscript: \"论文撰写\",\n  concluded: \"已收束\",\n};\nconst STATUS_LABEL = {\n  proposed: \"已提出\",\n  testing: \"验证中\",\n  supported: \"获得支持\",\n  refuted: \"被否定\",\n  inconclusive: \"尚无定论\",\n  planned: \"已规划\",\n  running: \"运行中\",\n  concluded: \"已结束\",\n};\n\n// 假设状态机：允许的转移边。结论（supported/refuted/inconclusive）只能从 testing 产生；\n// 终态可因新证据回到 testing（重新验证）。\nconst HYP_TRANSITIONS = {\n  proposed: [\"testing\"],\n  testing: [\"supported\", \"refuted\", \"inconclusive\"],\n  supported: [\"testing\"],\n  refuted: [\"testing\"],\n  inconclusive: [\"testing\"],\n};\n\n// v1 → v2 迁移：补齐字段默认值（schema 2 起 artifacts/reviews 会真实写入与关联）\nconst MIGRATIONS = {\n  1: (m) => {\n    m.project = m.project ?? {};\n    m.question = m.question ?? { text: \"\", updatedAt: \"\" };\n    m.hypotheses = (m.hypotheses || []).map((h) => ({ reviews: [], ...h }));\n    m.loop = m.loop ?? { phase: \"literature\", iteration: 0, history: [] };\n    m.loop.history = Array.isArray(m.loop.history) ? m.loop.history : [];\n    m.experiments = (m.experiments || []).map((e) => ({ reviews: [], ...e }));\n    m.artifacts = Array.isArray(m.artifacts) ? m.artifacts : [];\n    m.reviews = Array.isArray(m.reviews) ? m.reviews : [];\n    return m;\n  },\n};\n\nfunction migrateManifest(m) {\n  let v = Number(m?.schema) || 1;\n  while (v < SCHEMA) {\n    const fn = MIGRATIONS[v];\n    if (fn) m = fn(m);\n    v += 1;\n  }\n  m.schema = SCHEMA;\n  return m;\n}\n\n// ── manifest 读写（原子写；写方在调用处持锁）─────────────────────────────────\n\nasync function manifestPath(root) {\n  return path.join(root, MANIFEST_FILE);\n}\n\nasync function loadManifest(root) {\n  const p = await manifestPath(root);\n  const m = await core.readJson(p, null);\n  if (!m) return null;\n  try {\n    return migrateManifest(m);\n  } catch (err) {\n    throw core.sciErr(\"ERR_IO\", `研究清单迁移失败 ${p}：${err.message}`);\n  }\n}\n\nasync function saveManifest(root, m) {\n  m.updatedAt = core.nowISO();\n  await core.writeJsonAtomic(await manifestPath(root), m);\n}\n\n// 工件索引（来自 artifact-registry 的 artifacts/artifacts.json，只读合并展示）\nasync function loadArtifactIndex(root) {\n  return core.readJson(path.join(root, \"artifacts\", \"artifacts.json\"), { artifacts: [] });\n}\n\n// ── 渲染 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunction renderDashboard(m, artifactIndex) {\n  const lines = [];\n  lines.push(`# 研究项目：${m.project.title}`);\n  lines.push(\n    `领域：${m.project.domain} ｜ 状态：${m.project.status} ｜ 循环阶段：${PHASE_LABEL[m.loop.phase] ?? m.loop.phase}（迭代 ${m.loop.iteration}）`\n  );\n  lines.push(\"\");\n  lines.push(\"## 研究问题\");\n  lines.push(m.question.text ? m.question.text : \"（尚未设定）\");\n  lines.push(\"\");\n  lines.push(`## 假设（${m.hypotheses.length}）`);\n  if (m.hypotheses.length === 0) lines.push(\"（暂无）\");\n  for (const h of m.hypotheses) {\n    lines.push(`- [${h.id}:${STATUS_LABEL[h.status] ?? h.status}] ${h.text}`);\n  }\n  lines.push(\"\");\n  lines.push(`## 实验（${m.experiments.length}）`);\n  if (m.experiments.length === 0) lines.push(\"（暂无）\");\n  for (const e of m.experiments) {\n    lines.push(`- [${e.id}:${STATUS_LABEL[e.status] ?? e.status}] ${e.title}（假设 ${e.hypothesis ?? \"—\"}）`);\n  }\n  lines.push(\"\");\n  const arts = artifactIndex?.artifacts ?? [];\n  lines.push(`## 工件（${arts.length}）｜ 评审（${m.reviews.length}）`);\n  if (arts.length > 0) {\n    for (const a of arts.slice(-8)) {\n      lines.push(`- ${a.name} v${a.latestVersion}${a.deprecated ? \"（已废弃）\" : \"\"}`);\n    }\n  }\n  lines.push(\"\");\n  const hist = m.loop.history.slice(-6);\n  lines.push(\"## 最近循环历史\");\n  if (hist.length === 0) lines.push(\"（暂无）\");\n  for (const h of hist) {\n    lines.push(`- [迭代 ${h.iteration}｜${PHASE_LABEL[h.phase] ??
